name: Percentage 14 Rate
definition: Rate expressed as a percentage, that is, in hundredths, for example, 0.7 is 7/10 of a percent, and 7.0 is 7% with 13 fractional digits maximum and 14 total digits.
format: Required format is digits with an optional decimal point, for example 1500.25, at most 14 digits in total, of which at most 13 after the decimal point
